attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kelu Grelan: 36-year-old man, 195 cm (very-tall), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: round full face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Exactly one coherent 36-year-old adult man appears, with one head, two natural arms, two readable hands, two legs, and no additional subject or duplicated anatomy.

Original-resolution inspection confirms the complete hair, head, both hands, polished seed case, asymmetric hems, practical trousers, boots, and both feet remain fully inside generous top, side, and bottom margins.

Visible brush planes, controlled illustrative facial modeling, matte skin, textured repaired cloth, warm parchment wash, and soft grounding shadow establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing without photography, plastic 3D, or cel-anime finish.

The very-tall conditioned-athletic adult, light-medium skin, long straight nose, narrow upper lip, blonde-gold pageboy, teal-brown repaired patchwork layers, broad folded collar, uneven divided hem, practical trousers, loose readable hands, and polished seed case are legible with no tattoo or accessory. However, the face is angular rather than round and full, the brows are heavy and angled rather than fine and straight, no single brow notch is clearly visible, and the fringe reads as a continuous blunt curve rather than a sharply stepped construction.
The narrow upper lip remains closed and unsmiling, with a calm imposing gaze and no grin or theatrical acting.

The repaired cloth outfit, practical trousers, worn boots, and seed case remain ordinary mortal details. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.

The blonde male subject, pageboy silhouette, teal-brown asymmetrical patchwork, seed case, and upright loose-handed pose do not reproduce the reference woman, heavy braid, ochre progression outfit, face, anatomy, or pose; only the authorized painterly register and parchment presentation carry over.
